newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA JULY INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT UP YR-YR 8.4 PCT.
newsitem.headline: CHINA JULY INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT UP YR-YR 8.4 PCT.

text.p: China's industrial output rose a year-on-year 8.4 percent to 162.5 billion yuan ($19.6 billion) in July, state television said on Friday, quoting the State Statistical Bureau.
The rate in increase of industrial output had fallen compared with that of the first half of the year because of lost working days due to exceptionally hot weather, state television said.
The sales ratio of industrial enterprises had risen further in July and overall efficiency continued to recover, it quoted the State Statistical Bureau as saying but gave no details.
In the first half of the year, China's state-owned enterprises had achieved total profits of 12.1 billion yuan, with losses from enterprises in the red controlled to some degree, it said.
However, the nation's industrial base remained weak, it said but did not elaborate.
